subject: planner: fix possible read-write DATA RACE on Instance Plan Cache (#58328)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent with focus on planner/expression concurrency and semantics. The instance plan cache change in `generateNewPlan` (`pkg/planner/core/plan_cache.go`) clones the newly-built plan before `Put`, so cache hits clone from a read-only copy instead of a plan concurrently being executed/mutated by the generating session. The expression change (`pkg/expression/constant.go`) removes mutations of `Constant.Value` for `ParamMarker` in `StringWithCtx` and `Eval`, which matches the instance plan cache behavior of sharing `SafeToShareAcrossSession` expressions and avoids cross-session read/write races. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, privilege/visibility, txn/session, or remaining obvious concurrency hazards found within the touched paths.
